        This project incorporates and extends GPL-licensed code and research from Kindle annotation parsing algorithms by John Howell (see https://github.com/K-R-D-S/KRDS). The  PDF coordinate system conversion methods and Amazon Kindle data format analysis were established by reverse engineering by the project maintainer (Marcin Miłkowski).
